initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 0.40 minus 0.30 = 0.10. Numerical verification does not establish causal identification. Please retrieve archived design record R214-1 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 24/60 − 27/90 = 0.10. R214-1 supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the counterfactual risks. Therefore, the requested average causal risk difference is not uniquely identified.
